turn: I added a test in src/reminders/cancellation.test.ts for the clinic-cancellation reminder SMS. It mocks the Skebby gateway module, then calls notifyClinicCancel with a phone number, an appointment time and the clinic name "Cagliari Centro". I haven't run the suite, so I can't say the test passes. As written, it also has no assertion: it never checks that the message contains the clinic name, even though the test is titled "message names the clinic". It only shows that the call completes without throwing. The next edit should be an expectation on the mocked sendSms arguments. In the same commit I made one small unplanned fix: I corrected the date formatting helper so that single-digit days and months are zero-padded in reminder text, for example "05/03" instead of "5/3". Next I'll start "Reminder SMS retry on gateway errors".

sidefix.title: Zero-pad day and month in reminders
sidefix.what: Fixed the reminder date formatting helper so single-digit days and months are zero-padded, e.g. 05/03 instead of 5/3.
